referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the entire transport life cycle. Port infrastructure expenditures and environmental interventions are allocated based the yearly throughput. Vessel manufacturing is allocated based on the total kilometric performance (6'921'600km) and its transport performance (1978t/unit). The canal demand is estimated based on the total transport performance on the Rhein (41400000000tkm) and the transport distance of 850km.; UUID: bc86dd57-602b-3d2e-a401-d5beae8da1ca
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module calls the modules addressing: production of vessel; construction and land use of port; operation, maintenance and disposal of port. In addition canal construction and maintenance are called. Also included are fuel useage and the emissions of vessel operation.
